title: Python package validation via tmux harness
objective: Turn the tmux Python/Metal import workaround into a repeatable validation harness for MLX package checks.

checklist.requirement: Create repeatable Python package validation probe
checklist.evidence: benchmarks/python/python_package_validation_probe.py validates import mlx, import mlx.core, Metal availability, default device, and minimal-env import
benchmarks/python/tmux_python_package_validation.py sends the probe to a named tmux pane, waits for JSON, captures completion marker, and writes harness JSON

checklist.requirement: Validate MLX package checks through tmux
checklist.evidence: python-package-validation-m244.json verdict PASS with Metal available true and default_device Device(gpu, 0)
minimal-env command returned 0 and stdout True Device(gpu, 0)
--fail-on-fail returns non-zero if pane, marker, output JSON, or probe verdict fails
